title: Concept: Whole input read into memory without a limit (javascript)
description: In javascript, fs.readFileSync copies the whole input into memory. The size is chosen by whoever supplies the input, so one request can allocate gigabytes and stall every other request on the worker.
applicability: Upload handlers, proxies, archive extractors and API clients; single-line lexical scope.
risk: Denial of service through memory exhaustion; MEDIUM severity.
